Chapter 6165: You’Re In The Way

Chapter 6165: You’re In The Way

The true flames converged and formed a frightening suction force culminating in a black hole. It drew all the surrounding time, space, and dao upon formation.

The stacking continued and the black hole increased in size.

“Rumble!” Immortal Suppression’s massive scorched territory was pulled up and twisted into nothingness.

The black hole’s growth showed no sign of stopping. When people looked up, it resembled the gaping jaw of a primal monster.

“Ahh!” Eventually, its radius affected cultivators and mortals, lifting them into the air and grinding them to pieces.

“This is terrifying.” An ancestor said, having never seen a black hole created from layers of true flames collapsing before. This could kill apex emperors without a doubt.

“Only this much power?” On the other hand, Li Qiye’s voice reached everyone.

He stood in the center of the black hole, completely unscathed. He placed his palms together and kneaded the flames into a sphere.

“You can have it back.” He smiled and threw the fiery sphere at the opponents.

All of the powers gathered by the emperors have been condensed into this tiny sphere. Therefore, its destructive potential was unmatched.

“Boom!” It exploded and burned what remained of Immortal Suppression to a crisp.

The supreme momentum and imperial formations shattered and became smoke.

“Go!” The emperors were aghast because although the sphere originated from them, it became far more powerful than before after Li Qiye’s brief refinement.

Running was impossible so they utilized their strongest defense. Yangrune who has been waiting on the sideline summoned his shield.

It released suns with dark runes to form a towering wall made of stacked dimensions.

“Darkrune Dao Wall, a perfect mastery of the spatial dao, this could be stronger than the diamond physique!” An emperor couldn’t help but praise.

However, the sphere still destroyed the wall and the emperors’ defenses.

“Ahh!” They were reduced to ashes upon contact. Their immortal shell, dao fruits, and anima tree weren’t tough enough to endure.

The final survivor was Allmountain since he was the strongest. Unfortunately, he only lasted a few seconds longer than the rest.

“Bam!” His defense shattered and he could only watch the fiery sphere approach.

In this final moment, Li Qiye pulled him away, successfully saving him. When he fell to the ground, he was drenched in sweat.

“Why did you save me?” He asked.

“I told you I would spare you.” Li Qiye said.

Allmountain had forgotten about this back in Splendor Terra. He dismissed it as a joke from an ignorant brat but now, it turned out to be his saving grace.

“Bam!” He didn’t have time to regain his composure since Li Qiye flicked him into the horizon, disappearing entirely.

“You’re in the way.” Li Qiye smiled.

Four apex emperors met their end after the exchange; one was seriously wounded.

“I can’t believe it.” A spectator murmured.
